question.worked_solution:
The given repeating decimal can be expressed as

$$
\begin{aligned}6.\overset{―}{3} & =6.333… \\  & =6+0.3+0.03+0.003+… \\  & =6+(\frac{3}{10}+\frac{3}{100}+\frac{3}{1\,000}+…).\end{aligned}
$$

The series in the parentheses is a geometric series with first term ${a}_{1}=\frac{3}{10}$ and common ratio $r=\frac{1}{10}.$ Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}6.\overset{―}{3} & =6+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }{a}_{1}{r}^{n-1} \\  & =6+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{3}{10}{(\frac{1}{10})}^{n-1} \\  & =6+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }3(\frac{1}{10}){(\frac{1}{10})}^{n-1} \\  & =6+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }3{(\frac{1}{10})}^{n}.\end{aligned}
$$
